The '''Arcon Multinode Hybrid Plantings''' were an [[Farm/Legends|agricultural]] development on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]. Located close to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pandath/Legends|Pandath]], the plantings were owned by [[Arcon Multinode Agricorp]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
